Valuations.title: Valuation history
Valuations.signIn: Sign in to view your private valuation history.
Valuations.perUnit: All estimates and source prices are per unit. Quantity does not multiply these amounts.
Valuations.order: Newest observation first. History remains on this item after a quantity split.
Valuations.utcHelp: Earlier times are entered in UTC, including milliseconds. Now uses the saved server time.
Valuations.moneyHelp: Use 1,234.56 grouping and decimal separators. This currency allows {digits} decimal places. No rounding.
Valuations.formError: Check the amount, currency, UTC time and private note.
Valuations.saved: Estimate saved. A backdated entry may not be the latest estimate.
Valuations.scopeHelp: Historical mappings show retained sources for this catalog reference, not items previously linked here. No combined market value is calculated.
Valuations.UNLINKED: No catalog reference linked. You can link one in the item editor.
Valuations.INACTIVE_VARIANT: This catalog variant is retired. Current sources are unavailable. Personal estimates remain independent.
Valuations.NO_SUPPORTED_MAPPING: No supported source mapping for this catalog reference.
Valuations.DISPLAY_DISABLED: External values are not enabled for display.
Valuations.NO_OBSERVATIONS: No eligible observations in this mapping scope.
Valuations.variant: This item uses a specific catalog variant.
Valuations.conflict: Multiple currencies; no conversion. This considers the latest personal estimate and all eligible external source groups in this mapping scope.
Valuations.FETCH: Source time not supplied; fetch time used
Valuations.revisionChanged: Catalog revision has changed since this observation.
Valuations.identifierChanged: The mapping record has been renewed.
Valuations.readError: History could not be loaded. Try reading it again.
Valuations.refreshAfterSave: Saved; history could not be refreshed. The confirmed entry is shown below.
Valuations.mappingChanged: Source mapping changed or is unavailable. History was checked again; retry if needed.
Valuations.inactive: This item is read-only. Personal history is retained.
Valuations.limit: The personal history limit has been reached. Further entries are disabled.
Valuations.validationError: This entry was rejected. Check your input and item state.
Valuations.unknown: Saving could not be confirmed and may have succeeded. Check history before starting another entry. Refreshing never repeats the save.
Valuations.newEntry: Start a new entry (may duplicate the previous one)
Valuations.stale: Displayed history may be out of date.
Valuations.session: Your session ended. Sign in again to view this private history.
Valuations.discardLanguage: Discard draft and switch language to {language}

Search.title: Search your collection
Search.intro: Find your own items using text and precise conditions.
Search.tokenHelp: The address contains only a random identifier. Unsaved searches are available only in this tab.
Search.textHelp: Searches titles, public descriptions, tags, identifiers, grading and available text fields. Private notes and wishlists are excluded.
Search.total: {count, plural, =0 {0 matching items} one {# matching item} other {# matching items}}
Search.ownedScope: Your own items only. Public visibility does not expand this scope.
Search.liveRead: Live results · read at {time} UTC. Each page is read afresh.
Search.stale: Stale results: refresh failed. The displayed read time still applies.
Search.invalidDraft: Review the conditions and their values. The filter is incomplete or invalid.
Search.draftPending: Unapplied draft. Apply to update the results.
Search.discardHelp: Your unapplied changes will be lost.
Search.utcHelp: UTC including milliseconds: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ. No local-time conversion.
Search.dateHelp: Calendar date without a time zone (YYYY-MM-DD).
Search.customIdentityHelp: Custom selection values may be absent: unknown values match no items.
Search.moneyHelp: Amounts per unit. The latest personal estimate is selected before currency and range checks. A newer USD estimate replaces an older EUR estimate.
Search.legacyMoneyHelp: Amount ranges need an approved interpretation of legacy units. Present/Missing remains available.
Search.conditionHelp: Exact option, including retained retired options. Missing applies only within this category.
Search.gradingHelp: Authored values are matched exactly. Comparable values require the same provider and scale.
Search.visibilityHelp: Compares authored visibility, not effective access rights.
Search.presenceHelp: Zero, false and a stored empty multi-selection count as present.
Search.unavailableFamily: This filter cannot run yet. Change or remove the unavailable condition; its values remain in the draft.
Search.unavailableReference: This definition is unavailable or its type changed. Choose a valid definition.
Search.referenceFailed: Labels could not be loaded. Selections are preserved.
Search.tooComplex: At most five logical levels and 50 conditions are allowed.
Search.collapsedLeaf: Values are retained. Choose Edit to inspect and change them.
Search.builderHelp: Nest conditions, combine them with AND/OR and negate them. Changes run only when you choose Apply.

errors.invalidUrl: The search address is invalid. Explicitly reset the search.
errors.missingToken: This search is not available in this tab. It may have been copied or evicted from tab storage.
errors.session: Your session expired. Private search data was cleared.
errors.invalid: The request is invalid or too large. Review the filter or restart on the first page.
errors.unavailable: The search contains an unavailable condition or reference. Please repair the filter.
errors.failed: Search could not be loaded. Please retry.
